title: BuildPalette mod
description:
Gives you the building blocks quickly
by defining ready-made palettes
body:
🛠️ MBuild Mod – Custom Hotbar Palettes
MBuild Mod is a must-have utility for every Minecraft builder! This client-side mod allows you to save, manage, and instantly equip entire hotbar layouts with a single command.

Tired of constantly searching for that exact block palette you love to build with? Now you can create custom block palettes, swap between them in milliseconds, and save hours of tedious inventory management.

✨ Key Features
💾 Smart Saving: Save all 9 slots of your current hotbar under a unique, custom name.

🌐 Global Sync (Local Cloud-Like Saving): Your palettes are saved locally in your PC's config folder. This means your saved hotbars work everywhere! If you create a palette in Singleplayer, you can instantly load it while playing on any Multiplayer server.

⚡ Clean Chat (No Spam): The mod utilizes direct client-server network packets (CreativeInventoryActionC2SPacket) to update your inventory, completely avoiding annoying server chat spam like [Given 64 Stone to Player].

🔄 Seamless Swapping: When loading a palette, your old hotbar is automatically cleared, and the new blocks are placed precisely into their designated slots without "leaking" into your main inventory.

⚠️ Permissions Notice:
To retrieve blocks into your hand (the give command), the mod requires you to be in Creative Mode or have OP permissions on the server you are playing on. The mod relies on native Creative Mode mechanics to seamlessly update the server with your new hotbar layout.

🎮 Mod Commands
All commands start with /mbuild and feature full Tab-Completion for maximum convenience:

/mbuild create [name] – Saves the 9 items currently in your hotbar under the specified name.

/mbuild give [name] – Clears your current hotbar and replaces it with the saved palette (in stacks of 64).

/mbuild delete [name] – Deletes a saved palette from your local configuration.

💾 Installation
Make sure you have Fabric Loader installed for Minecraft 1.21.4 (or above).

Download the mod and drop the .jar file into your mods folder: %appdata%\.minecraft\mods.

Launch the game and start building in style!
